_comment: VS Code / GitHub Copilot (agent mode) → hosted OmniMind MCP. File: .vscode/mcp.json in the workspace, or the user-level mcp.json via 'MCP: Open User Configuration' / 'MCP: Add Server'. Shape: servers.<name>.type = "http" (required; "sse" is the other value), url, headers. The `inputs` promptString with password: true makes VS Code ask for the token once when the server first starts and keep it in its secret store — never commit a literal omt_ value in a workspace file (${env:NAME} also works). Servers needing interactive inputs are not forwarded to Copilot harness sessions; for those use the literal one-liner: code --add-mcp '{"name":"omnimind","type":"http","url":"https://omnimind-mcp-production.up.railway.app/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer omt_…"}}'. Token: BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools. Add '.github/copilot-instructions.md' with 'Start with OmniMind status_get; log decisions with decision_log' for the freshness contract (docs/runbooks/omnimind-mcp.md §8). Copilot Studio (the enterprise agent builder) rejects SSE servers; this one is Streamable HTTP only, which is fine.

inputs.description: OmniMind personal token (omt_…) from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools
